narr: A multi-day severe weather event unfolded across Central Alabama from May 16th through May 18th, 2023. An active northwest flow pattern coupled with a stalled out surface frontal boundary provided the ingredients necessary for strong to severe thunderstorms to develop during the heating of the day.
ev: Several streets in Gadsden covered in swift moving water and one vehicle flooded.
High water levels and flooding reported along Highway 79 in Cleveland.
